summary: The gate failure was a flaky integration test, and the cause was a real gap in the byte accounting. A client's first bytes can already sit in the hijacked connection's read buffer. The proxy forwarded those to the backend but didn't add them to `bytes_to_backend`, so `TestStreamDetachedWithAccessLogging` sometimes saw 24 bytes instead of 25. I now count those buffered bytes in `streaming.go`. After the fix, the integration and reverseproxy packages passed on the final run and on several earlier reruns. I removed the temporary stderr redirect I had added to `TestMain` to read the failure. I did not rerun the caddyhttp, encode and intercept packages after this fix, and nothing else in them changed.
